Atrexis the Grave Knight, Lyn the Ignored, Arcane Anomaly, Arcanic Enigma, Unstable Sentinel, Mana Devourer, Fel Ancient, Shade of the Archmage.

Most of the city’s monsters are immune to something. Many take no Arcane damage. The constructs and the elementals take no bleed or poison: Rake, Rip, Rend, rogues’ poisons and Serpent Sting do nothing to them. The treants can bleed but take no Nature damage. A Blizzard developer said on the official podcast of October 8 that the arcane immunity is on purpose.

Each kill gives Kirin Tor reputation: 5 for most enemies and for the Arcane Anomaly, Arcanic Enigma, Unstable Sentinel and Mana Devourer, 12 to 13 for the elites of the sewers, 15 for Atrexis, 25 for Lyn the Ignored and the Shade of the Archmage. At Friendly, Archmage Alvareaux, the Kirin Tor quartermaster in the city, sells eight recipes for Blacksmithing, Leatherworking and Tailoring (skill 175); the Kirin Tor Tabard asks Exalted. Since the October 15 update, the Horde no longer earns this reputation: the recipes and the tabard are for the Alliance.
Backfiring enchantments, arcane constructs, demonic energy and cats. Blizzard calls it a whole city to explore.
